review_text: Almond Delight is exactly what I remembered from my grandmother's paan. No tobacco no spit. Eat and swallow. Family loved it.
Ordered for Sunday lunch. Husband approved. Better than the Kalbadevi paan wala from his college days.
Cranberry is a strange ingredient in paan but it works. Bought a second box.
My Sunday paan ritual is back. The kids can even have a small bite which I would never allow with the paan wala one.
I cannot remember the last time I ate a paan I did not have to spit out. This is the first.
Granola Goodness arrived a bit soft. Otherwise interesting product. Will try again in winter.
Festival in a box. Sent to in-laws. Their first response was a phone call to ask where I bought it.
Meetha Paan is the new evening ritual at our place. Tobacco free is the reason my mother in law eats it with me.
Bought because the page said spit-free. Confirmed. Cleaner experience than I expected.
Pricey but I see why after tasting. Will buy again for special occasions.
Got this from a wedding. Bought again. The packaging itself feels like a gift.
Shipped in summer to Delhi. Almond Delight had melted on edges. Taste was still good. Pack a cooler next time.
Started with Granola now my partner is hooked on the Meetha Paan.
Mukhwas hand roasted clearly. Better than the loose mukhwas at sweet shops. Pack size small for the price.
